name: reveal
description: Make a hidden entity known when the player notices, finds, or reaches it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the hidden entity.

name: move
description: Move an actor to a new location, or move a nearby item.

entity_id.description: Exact actor or item id. The item must be carried by the player or loose here.

to_id.description: Exact destination id. An actor moves to a location id. An item is taken by moving it to `player`, handed over by moving it to an actor here, and dropped by moving it to the id of the player's current location.

name: add_trait
description: Add a lasting condition or quality to an entity.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

name.description: The trait's display name, such as `Battle Worn`; its id is derived.

text.description: The trait's effect in plain language.

name: remove_trait
description: Remove a lasting condition or quality that has ended.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Exact id of one of the entity's traits.

name: kill
description: Record that an actor has died. Their body and what they carried stay in the world.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor who has died. They must be here with the player.

name: unlock_exit
description: Unlock an exit from the player's location.

to_id.description: Exact id of the exit's destination.

name: join_party
description: Add an actor here to the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor joining.

name: leave_party
description: Remove an actor from the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor leaving.

name: advance_thread
description: Update an active storyline's status or note.

thread_id.description: Exact id of an ACTIVE THREAD.

status.description: New status, or null to keep the current status.

note.description: New private note for the Director, or null to keep the current note.

name: stake_check
description: Show the player one check's `risk` and let them accept or revise it before rolling.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

goal.description: The actor's goal, in one line.

risk.description: One-line cost of a bad roll, told to the player first. No roll without one.

dangerous.description: True when failing could harm the actor; a vulnerable actor may then die.

skill.description: The skill rolled, or empty when an item or a stunt is used.

item_id.description: Exact id of a carried item rolled in place of a skill, or null.

stunt.description: True to roll a d12 stunt instead of a skill or item.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who also rolls and shares the risk, or null.

helper_skill.description: The helper's skill, or empty when they use an item.

helper_item_id.description: Exact id of the item the helper rolls instead, or null.

helper_stunt.description: True when the helper stunts instead.

name: roll_check
description: Roll an actor's risky check directly. For the player, use `stake_check` first unless they already accepted the exact `risk`.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

goal.description: The actor's goal, in one line.

risk.description: One-line cost of a bad roll, told to the player first. No roll without one.

dangerous.description: True when failing could harm the actor; a vulnerable actor may then die.

skill.description: The skill rolled, or empty when an item or a stunt is used.

item_id.description: Exact id of a carried item rolled in place of a skill, or null.

stunt.description: True to roll a d12 stunt instead of a skill or item.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who also rolls and shares the risk, or null.

helper_skill.description: The helper's skill, or empty when they use an item.

helper_item_id.description: Exact id of the item the helper rolls instead, or null.

helper_stunt.description: True when the helper stunts instead.

name: test_luck
description: Let a die decide whether something happens.

subject.description: What may happen, in one line.

die.description: Die rated by the odds: d4 unlikely, d12 near certain.

name: loot_check
description: Roll the actor's loot die to scavenge, when the fiction allows it.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who scavenges.

seeking.description: The item they hope to find, named like `a crowbar`.

name: change_stress
description: Add stress for a complication, or clear it for a secure rest.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or an actor here.

amount.description: Positive adds stress; negative clears it.

why.description: The complication or the rest, in one line.

name: use_med_kit
description: Spend the actor's med kit to clear 2 stress, when they say they use it.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or a party member here.
